typedef long long ll;

vector<int> sieveEratosthenes(int n) {
    if (n < 2) return vector<int>();
    vector<bool> composite(n + 1, false);
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (!composite[i]) {
            ++count;
            if ((ll)i * i <= n) {
                for (int j = i * i; j <= n; j += i) {
                    composite[j] = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    vector<int> ret(count);
    int pos = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (!composite[i]) {
            ret[pos++] = i;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

class LongHashCounterL {
public:
    vector<ll> keys;
    vector<ll> values;
    vector<bool> occupied;
    int scale;
    int rscale;
    int mask;
    int size;
    static const int NG = 0;

    LongHashCounterL() : scale(1 << 2), rscale(1 << 1), mask(scale - 1), size(0) {
        keys.resize(scale, 0);
        values.resize(scale, 0);
        occupied.resize(scale, false);
    }

    bool containsKey(ll x) {
        int pos = h(x) & mask;
        while (occupied[pos]) {
            if (x == keys[pos]) return true;
            pos = (pos + 1) & mask;
        }
        return false;
    }

    ll get(ll x) {
        int pos = h(x) & mask;
        while (occupied[pos]) {
            if (x == keys[pos]) return values[pos];
            pos = (pos + 1) & mask;
        }
        return NG;
    }

    ll put(ll x, ll v) {
        int pos = h(x) & mask;
        while (occupied[pos]) {
            if (x == keys[pos]) {
                ll oldval = values[pos];
                values[pos] = v;
                return oldval;
            }
            pos = (pos + 1) & mask;
        }
        if (size == rscale) {
            resizeAndPut(x, v);
        } else {
            keys[pos] = x;
            values[pos] = v;
            occupied[pos] = true;
        }
        ++size;
        return 0;
    }

    ll inc(ll x, ll v) {
        int pos = h(x) & mask;
        while (occupied[pos]) {
            if (x == keys[pos]) {
                values[pos] += v;
                return values[pos];
            }
            pos = (pos + 1) & mask;
        }
        if (size == rscale) {
            resizeAndPut(x, v);
        } else {
            keys[pos] = x;
            values[pos] = v;
            occupied[pos] = true;
        }
        ++size;
        return v;
    }

    bool remove(ll x) {
        int pos = h(x) & mask;
        while (occupied[pos]) {
            if (x == keys[pos]) {
                --size;
                int last = pos;
                pos = (pos + 1) & mask;
                while (occupied[pos]) {
                    int lh = h(keys[pos]) & mask;
                    if (lh <= last && last < pos || pos < lh && lh <= last || last < pos && pos < lh) {
                        keys[last] = keys[pos];
                        values[last] = values[pos];
                        last = pos;
                    }
                    pos = (pos + 1) & mask;
                }
                keys[last] = 0;
                values[last] = 0;
                occupied[last] = false;
                return true;
            }
            pos = (pos + 1) & mask;
        }
        return false;
    }

    int next(int itr) {
        while (itr < scale && !occupied[itr]) ++itr;
        return itr;
    }

private:
    void resizeAndPut(ll x, ll v) {
        int nscale = scale << 1;
        int nrscale = rscale << 1;
        int nmask = nscale - 1;
        vector<ll> nkeys(nscale, 0);
        vector<ll> nvalues(nscale, 0);
        vector<bool> noccupied(nscale, false);
        for (int i = next(0); i < scale; i = next(i + 1)) {
            ll y = keys[i];
            int pos = h(y) & nmask;
            while (noccupied[pos]) pos = (pos + 1) & nmask;
            nkeys[pos] = y;
            nvalues[pos] = values[i];
            noccupied[pos] = true;
        }
        {
            int pos = h(x) & nmask;
            while (noccupied[pos]) pos = (pos + 1) & nmask;
            nkeys[pos] = x;
            nvalues[pos] = v;
            noccupied[pos] = true;
        }
        keys.swap(nkeys);
        values.swap(nvalues);
        occupied.swap(noccupied);
        scale = nscale;
        rscale = nrscale;
        mask = nmask;
    }

    int h(ll x) {
        uint64_t ux = (uint64_t)x;
        ux ^= ux >> 33;
        ux *= 0xff51afd7ed558ccdULL;
        ux ^= ux >> 33;
        ux *= 0xc4ceb9fe1a85ec53ULL;
        ux ^= ux >> 33;
        return (int)ux;
    }
};

class MeisselLehmer2 {
public:
    vector<int> primes;
    vector<int> xcums;
    vector<unsigned long long> isp;
    int cachelimit;
    LongHashCounterL picache;
    LongHashCounterL phicache;
    vector<vector<int>> cumps;
    vector<int> FP;
    int M;
    int B;

    MeisselLehmer2(ll n) {
        assert(n >= 4);
        M = 8;
        B = 100;
        FP = {2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19};
        int s = (int)sqrt((double)n) * B;
        cachelimit = s;
        this->primes = sieveEratosthenes(s);
        int size = (s >> 6) + 1;
        xcums.assign(size, 0);
        isp.assign(size, 0ULL);
        for (int p : primes) {
            isp[p >> 6] |= 1ULL << p;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < size - 1; ++i) {
            xcums[i + 1] = xcums[i] + __builtin_popcountll(isp[i]);
        }

        cumps.resize(M);
        vector<bool> b = {true};
        int len = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
            len *= FP[i];
            vector<bool> c(len, false);
            for (int j = 0; j < FP[i]; ++j) {
                copy(b.begin(), b.end(), c.begin() + j * b.size());
            }
            for (int k = 0; k < len; k += FP[i]) {
                c[k] = false;
            }
            cumps[i].resize(len + 1);
            for (int j = 0; j < len; ++j) {
                cumps[i][j + 1] = cumps[i][j] + (c[j] ? 1 : 0);
            }
            FP[i] = len;
            b.swap(c);
        }
    }

    ll sqrt(ll n) {
        ll i = max(0LL, (ll)sqrt((double)n) - 2);
        while (i * i <= n) ++i;
        return i - 1;
    }

    ll cbrt(ll n) {
        ll i = max(0LL, (ll)cbrt((double)n) - 2);
        while (i * i * i <= n) ++i;
        return i - 1;
    }

    ll pi(ll x) {
        if (x <= cachelimit) {
            int ix = (int)x;
            int shift = 63 - (ix & 63);
            unsigned long long shifted = isp[ix >> 6] << shift;
            return xcums[ix >> 6] + __builtin_popcountll(shifted);
        }
        if (picache.containsKey(x)) return picache.get(x);

        int A = (int)pi(sqrt(sqrt(x)));
        ll ret = A + phi(x, A) - P2(x, A) - P3(x, A) - 1;
        picache.put(x, ret);
        return ret;
    }

    ll phi(ll x, int A) {
        if (A > 0 && A - 1 < M) {
            return (ll)cumps[A - 1][FP[A - 1]] * (x / FP[A - 1]) + cumps[A - 1][(int)(x % FP[A - 1] + 1)];
        }
        if (A > 0 && x <= (ll)primes[A - 1] * primes[A - 1]) {
            return pi(x) - A + 1;
        }

        ll ret = x;
        for (int i = A - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
            ret -= phi(x / primes[i], i);
        }
        return ret;
    }

    ll P2(ll x, int A) {
        int B = (int)pi(sqrt((double)x));
        ll ret = 0;
        for (int i = A; i < B; ++i) {
            ret += pi(x / primes[i]);
        }
        ret -= (ll)(B - A) * (B + A - 1) / 2;
        return ret;
    }

    ll P3(ll x, int A) {
        int C = (int)pi(cbrt(x));
        ll ret = 0;
        for (int i = A; i < C; ++i) {
            ll xi = x / primes[i];
            int B = (int)pi(sqrt((double)xi));
            for (int j = i; j < B; ++j) {
                ret += pi(xi / primes[j]) - j;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
};

vector<int> primes = sieveEratosthenes(400000);

void solve() {
    ll n;
    scanf("%lld", &n);
    ll ans = 0;
    if (n <= 10) {
        if (n >= 6) ++ans;
        if (n >= 8) ++ans;
        if (n >= 10) ++ans;
        printf("%lld\n", ans);
        return;
    }

    MeisselLehmer2 ml(n / 2);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < primes.size(); ++i) {
        ll plus = ml.pi(n / primes[i]) - (i + 1);
        if (plus <= 0) break;
        ans += plus;
    }

    for (int p : primes) {
        if ((ll)p * p * p <= n) {
            ++ans;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
